scope: Rendered motion samples and seven rendered footage scene samples, plus end-of-take battle frames. Independent factual and visual review; full video playback and audio measurement are recorded separately.
notes: The filming harness uses the real fixed game viewport with the supported text scale 1.5.
Later-round starts and Mewtwo/Ho-Oh HP thresholds are staged and disclosed in source-audit.json.
The ordinary Lugia final battle is used; the trailer makes no claim that dark-form transformation is shown.
limitations: Frame samples cannot establish every intermediate frame or subjective audio quality. See validation.json and playback-validation.json for automated checks.
